title: XLAI Turn Semantic Safety Result
description: A versioned internal-only result from the future Turn Semantic Safety Classifier. It is a shadow-mode semantic observation for comparison and evaluation, not generated text, cumulative conversation state, or enforcement policy. Numeric confidence is optional experimental metadata only and is not inherently a probability, calibrated correctness estimate, risk probability, or policy input.

ontologyVersion.description: Semantic signal ontology version used for this result.

policyReferenceVersion.description: Authoritative Safety Knowledge Base taxonomy reference; it does not grant enforcement authority.

category.description: One existing Safety Knowledge Base category key, or null when inference abstains or fails. It is not the authoritative runtime decision category.

level.description: Semantic prediction using the existing XLAI safety-level range, or null when inference abstains or fails. It is not the authoritative runtime decision level.

confidence.description: Optional experimental bounded model score. This does not imply a calibrated probability, user-facing confidence, risk probability, threshold, or policy input.

semanticSignals.description: Governed semantic ontology signal IDs only; these do not replace deterministic matched signals or policy.

resolution.description: Model interpretation resolution, distinct from human corpus annotationCertainty. Null is used only when inference does not produce a semantic result.

evidence.description: Structured references into transiently supplied current or bounded context turns. Persistent results store offsets, not raw excerpts.

inferenceStatus.description: Operational inference outcome, distinct from semantic resolution and deterministic runtime behavior.

contextFlags.description: Optional bounded-context indicators; not cumulative state.
